description: Source code for NGAP common structures and methods, including private IE ID handling, JSON serialization, packing/unpacking, and class definitions.

classes.name: private_ie_id_c
classes.description: Represents a private Information Element ID with options for local or global types.

classes.name: private_ie_field_s
classes.description: Template class for handling private IE fields, including packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

classes.name: private_ie_container_item_s
classes.description: Template class for container items of private IEs, supporting packing, unpacking, and JSON serialization.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets the type of private_ie_id_c to a specified option.

methods.name: set_local
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c type to local and returns the local ID.

methods.name: set_global
methods.description: Sets the private_ie_id_c type to global.

methods.name: pack
methods.description: Packs the private_ie_id_c or IE field/container item into a bit reference.

methods.name: unpack
methods.description: Unpacks the private_ie_id_c or IE field/container item from a bit reference.
